author: Marryat, 1819

note.en: A small, finely latticed snail of rubble, collected at Manzanillo (25 m, 2000) and Limón. Rarely noticed.
note.es: Un caracol pequeño de fina reticulación del escombro, recolectado en Manzanillo (25 m, 2000) y Limón. Rara vez se nota.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
